defects: Integrability hypothesis is stated on the closed ray Ici (N : ℝ) instead of the open ray Ioi (N : ℝ) as in gold (mathematically equivalent since {N} is a null set, but not a literal match)
Nonnegativity hypothesis is stated on Ici (N : ℝ) instead of Ioi (N : ℝ) as in gold (derivable from the other hypotheses so equivalent, but not a literal match)

Conclusion is phrased as summability of an indicator sequence (0 below N, f n from N on) rather than gold's direct Summable (fun n => f n) over all naturals; equivalent since both differ from the tail sum by only finitely many terms, but structurally different from gold
